findings.description: Both overloads QDimensionModularForms(chi::GrpDrchElt,k) (line 62-65) and QDimensionModularForms(N::RngIntElt,k) (line 67-70) claim to return the Q-dimension of the full modular forms space M_k, but Dimension(ModularSymbols(...,-1)) is not dim M_k in any convention: for trivial character the sign -1 subspace of full modular symbols usually equals the cusp dimension (and not even that always, e.g. N=9 k=2 gives 1 while dim S=0), and for nontrivial characters it equals dim S_k + (roughly) half the Eisenstein dimension. Correct behavior per the docstring is dim M_k = dim S_k + dim E_k. Verified fix identity: Dimension(ModularForms(chi,k)) = QDimensionCuspForms(chi,k)+QDimensionEisensteinForms(chi,k) holds for all orbit reps N<=20, k in 2..4, and dim M_k(Gamma0(N)) = QDimensionCuspForms(N,k)+QDimensionEisensteinForms(N,k) for N<=30, k in {2,4,6} (odd k needs a 0 guard because QDimensionCuspForms(N,k)=tomo1 assumes even k, see separate finding).

Systematic sweep (t1.m): every (N,k) with dim E_k > 0 mismatches, e.g. N=12 k=4: QDimMF=3 dimM=9 dimS=3.

findings.description: In QDimensionCuspForms(chi::GrpDrchElt,k) the weight-1 special case 'if k eq 1 then return Dimension(ModularForms(chi,k)); end if;' returns the dimension of the FULL space M_1(N,chi) (cusp + Eisenstein) instead of the cuspidal dimension S_1(N,chi). Correct behavior: return Dimension(CuspidalSubspace(ModularForms(chi,1))), which matches LMFDB mf_newspaces cusp_dim in every test. This also silently corrupts QDimensionNewCuspForms(chi,1) (line 172, computed as cusp - old) and, through it, weight-1 old/new dimensions at higher levels.

findings.description: [Definition begins at line 711, just outside my assigned range -- reported courtesy with evidence for the 615-1227 auditor to dedupe.] newpopa1(k,N,n), used by NewTrace(N,k,n) whenever GCD(N,n)>1, is wrong whenever the d>1 terms of its divisor sum are active, i.e. whenever GCD(Squarefree(N),ssr(n))>1 (n divisible by p^2 for a prime p in the squarefree part of N). Three defects: (a) the inner Hecke index must be n div d^2, not n; (b) the inner level sum must run over divisors of N/d with beta evaluated at (N/d)/M, not over divisors of N; (c) d must range over divisors of GCD(prod of primes EXACTLY dividing N, ssr(n)) -- Squarefree(N) wrongly includes p when p^3||N (fails at N=8, 24, 27). Corrected version verified against modular-symbols new-subspace Hecke traces in 1632 cases (N<=32, k in {2,4,6}, n in [2..18]) with 0 failures.

findings.description: Both QDimensionModularForms signatures ((chi,k) at line 62-65 and (N,k) at line 67-70) claim to return the Q-dimension of the space M_k of MODULAR forms, but they return Dimension(ModularSymbols(...,-1))*Degree. Sign -1 modular symbols contain no Eisenstein boundary for trivial character (so the result is the CUSP dimension dim S_k, not dim M_k), and for odd weight/nontrivial character the Eisenstein boundary splits between the +1 and -1 eigenspaces, so the result is neither dim M_k nor dim S_k. Correct behavior per the docstring is QDim S_k + QDim E_k; both summands are already correctly implemented in this module (verified against Magma: QDimensionCuspForms matched Dimension(CuspForms(chi,k)) for all N<=36, all Conrey n, k=2..5; QDimensionEisensteinForms matched Dimension(EisensteinSubspace(ModularForms(chi,k))) for all N<=24, k=1..5). The fix check line in the evidence shows cusp+eis reproduces the true M_k Q-dimensions (2, 4, 4) in all three failing examples.

QDimensionModularForms(11,2)=1 dimM=2 dimS=1
QDimensionModularForms(14,2)=1 dimM=4 dimS=1

> QDimensionCuspForms(11,1,2)+QDimensionEisensteinForms(11,1,2), QDimensionCuspForms(14,1,2)+QDimensionEisensteinForms(14,1,2), QDimensionCuspForms(7,3,3)*Degree(7,3)+QDimensionEisensteinForms(7,3,3);
fix check: 2 4 4   // proposed fix matches Magma's dim M in all three cases
(Magma's Dimension(ModularForms(chi,k)) is the Q-dimension/Galois-orbit sum: for chi=7.3 order 6, dim E_3 = 2 conjugates x lambda=2 -> 4, dim S_3 = 0, both confirmed by CuspForms/EisensteinSubspace and LMFDB.)

findings.description: In QDimensionCuspForms(chi::GrpDrchElt,k) the weight-1 branch returns Dimension(ModularForms(chi,1)) — the FULL modular forms space, including the Eisenstein subspace — instead of the cuspidal subspace. Since dim E_1(N,chi) > 0 for every odd character, the result is always too large by the weight-1 Eisenstein dimension. This propagates to QDimensionNewCuspForms(chi,1) (line 172, which returns cusp - old) and QDimensionOldCuspForms(chi,1) (line 201, which sums the new dims over sublevels): for the quadratic character mod 23, new is reported as 2 instead of 1; lifting that character to modulus 46, cusp and old are both reported as 4 instead of 2. Oracle: Magma's Dimension(CuspidalSubspace(ModularForms(chi,1))) and LMFDB mf_newspaces (23.1.b has cusp_dim=1, eis_dim=1).

Docstring of QDimensionNewEisensteinForms(N::RngIntElt,k::RngIntElt) says "The Q-dimension of the space E_k(N,chi) of Eisenstein series of weight k for Gamma0(N)" — identical to the docstring of QDimensionEisensteinForms(N,k) at line 247 — but the intrinsic returns the NEW subspace dimension (it calls QDimensionNewEisensteinForms(N,1,k)). OUT OF MY ASSIGNED RANGE (1-614) — cross-reference for the auditor of lines 615-1227. NewTrace(N,k,n) returns wrong values whenever n = p^e with e >= 2 for a prime p exactly dividing N (v_p(N)=1); e.g. NewTrace(6,4,4)=36 vs true 4, NewTrace(14,2,4)=3 vs true 1, NewTrace(3,6,9)=19764/2? (pkg 19764 doubled-convention value vs oracle 162/2=81). CuspTrace (which uses popa1 for gcd(N,n)>1) is correct in ALL tested cases (N<=20, k in {2,4,6}, n<=10), so the bug is in the newform Moebius/Atkin-Lehner-lift convolution newpopa1 (line 711-713) or beta (line 707), not in popa1 or its helpers. Likely cause: the inner call popa1(k,M,n) uses n instead of n div d^2 in the d-indexed sum implementing Child21 Lemma 10. Cases with v_p(N)>=2 (e.g. N=12,n=4; N=18,n=9) and all gcd(N,n)=1 or squarefree-n cases are correct.

TESTED EMPIRICALLY (intrinsics): CuspTrace (vs ModSym Hecke traces, N<=24, k<=6, n<=12, incl. non-coprime n: 0 mismatches), CuspTrace1 (vs tau and CuspTrace(1,k,p)), NewTrace (vs LMFDB mf_newforms trace sums over 66 (N,k) pairs x n=1..12 AND vs ModSym new-subspace traces — found high-severity bug), NewTraces (vs NewTrace per prime, N<=40), FrickeCuspTrace (vs ModSym AtkinLehner*Hecke, N<=20, k<=6: 0 mismatches), FrickeNewTrace (all three branches n=1/prime/coprime-composite vs LMFDB fricke_eigenval-weighted traces: 0 mismatches), ALNewTrace (vs LMFDB w_Q-weighted traces, all exact divisors Q, n=1..12: 0 mismatches), ALNewDims (vs LMFDB per-signature dims incl. lex-ordering check with 2- and 3-prime levels and N=1 edge: 0 mismatches), FrickeNewDims (vs LMFDB: 0 mismatches), FrickeNewTraces (always crashes — bug), ALNewTraces (default crashes; PrimesOnly:=false contradicts doc — bugs), QDimensionCuspForms/QDimensionNewCuspForms (vs Magma Dimension(CuspForms)/NewSubspace, N<=60, k in {2,4,6,8,12}: 0 mismatches; garbage for odd k — missing require), SturmBound (vs LMFDB mf_newspaces.sturm_bound, 66 hard values), TraceForm (vs gp mftraceform and LMFDB — semantics are new-space, doc wrong). READ ONLY (dead code, no independent oracle attempted): newtomo2/newtomo3/newtomobadp (only reachable via unused newersz1p), Kd (duplicate defs at 762/801, identical), atkl/htl/ctlraw, SNd/SNndnn/SNQdnn/SNn, hf/HH, delta/Q, phi1D, f/g funcs 886-896, cuspsz/cuspsz1/cuspszN/newszN (unused variants of validated sz functions), psi/psi4/psi3/epsi (only used by popa11 which tested correct), Sp/Spmin (only used by dead childmin), newersz1p (explicitly marked "TODO: currently broken" by the author — not audited further). findings.description: FrickeNewTraces always crashes: line 1179 does `f := newpopaNp(k,N);` but the local function newpopaNp (line 628) takes three arguments (k,N,p). The curried two-argument variant that this code expects was commented out (lines 650-656). Every invocation of the intrinsic raises a runtime error, so the intrinsic is unusable. Additionally the docstring (line 1176) is a copy-paste of FrickeNewTrace's: it says 'Trace of T(n)*W(N) on S_k^new(N) for n = 1 or prime' but the intended behavior (cf. NewTraces at line 1149) is a list of traces for primes p <= n. Correct behavior: return [newpopaNp(k,N,p) : p prime <= n]; newpopaNp itself is correct (validated via FrickeNewTrace against LMFDB fricke_eigenval-weighted newform traces for all p, including p|N).

ALNewTraces with the DEFAULT parameter PrimesOnly:=true always crashes: line 1198 calls newszp(k,N,Q) with three arguments, but the local function newszp (line 971) is declared `function newszp(k,m)` with two parameters; newszp in turn calls skp(k,mm) with two arguments though skp (line 920) takes (k,m,n). The intended curried function is newszp(k,m,n) with skp(k,mm,GCD(n,mm)), mirroring newsz(k,m,l,n) = sum_{mm|m} alpha(m/mm)*skm(k,mm,l,GCD(n,mm)) (line 963). I validated this reconstruction: with newszp(k,m,n) using skp(k,mm,GCD(n,mm)) (and the skp branch-swap fix, see separate finding at line 941), newszp(k,N,Q)(l) equals newsz(k,N,l,Q) for all k in {2,4,6}, N<=30, Q||N, primes l coprime to N (0 mismatches), and newsz itself is validated against LMFDB (ALNewTrace checks, 0 mismatches).

newpopa1 (lines 711-713), which NewTrace uses whenever GCD(N,n)>1, returns wrong values whenever some prime p exactly divides N and p^2 divides n (i.e. whenever the d>1 terms of the sum are triggered). 64 of 792 LMFDB comparisons (N<=30, k<=6, n<=12) fail; errors can be enormous (see evidence). Three defects in the formula: (1) the inner popa1 must be called with n div d^2, not n; (2) the beta coefficient must exclude the primes in d and the divisor M must be coprime to d (coefficient beta(n div d^2, (N div M) div d) restricted to GCD(M,d)=1); (3) d must range over primes with Valuation(N,p) EQUAL to 1 (and p^2|n), whereas Divisors(GCD(Squarefree(N),ssr(n))) wrongly includes primes with v_p(N)=3 (demonstrated: keeping the Squarefree(N) range while fixing (1)-(2) gives 2048 instead of 0 for N=8,k=12,n=4). Derivation: in the old/new decomposition, for p||N with p not dividing M the U_p eigenvalues on the oldspace copies of a level-M newform are the roots of X^2-a_p X+p^{k-1}, giving Tr T_n S_k(N) = sum_{M|N} sigma_0((N/M)_{coprime to n}) sum_{d sqfree, d^2|n, p|d => p|N, p not | M} mu(d) d^{k-1} Tr T_{n/d^2} S_k^new(M); Moebius inversion prime-by-prime yields the fixed formula below. The fix was validated against Magma modular symbols new-subspace traces: 459/459 cases (N<=32, k in {2,4,6}, n in {2,...,18} with GCD(N,n)>1) plus weight-12 spot checks (N in {6,8,10,12,18,24,27}) and all 792 LMFDB values. Note NewTraces and the n-prime path of NewTrace are unaffected (d=1 only).
findings.evidence: NewTrace(6,4,4) = 36, but Tr T_4 on S_4^new(6) = 4 (LMFDB 6.4.a.a traces[4]=4; Magma: Trace(HeckeOperator(NewSubspace(CuspidalSubspace(ModularSymbols(6,4,1))),4)) = 4). NewTrace(12,12,9) = -26245804275 vs correct 118098 (modular symbols oracle). NewTrace(3,6,9) = 19764 vs correct 81 = a_3^2 (3.6.a.a). 64 mismatches total vs LMFDB (N<=30,k<=6,n<=12), all with p||N and p^2|n; corrected version: 0 mismatches on 459 modular-symbols oracle cases and all LMFDB cases.

findings.intrinsic: skp (local, used by ALNewTraces via newszp)
findings.description: In skp's k=2, not-IsSquare(mdivn) case (lines 934-944), the bodies of the IsSquarefree(n) and non-squarefree branches are swapped relative to the reference skm (lines 903-906): the IsSquarefree(n)=true branch (line 937) uses the conditional IsSquarefree(ndivnn)-select sum (harmless, since every ndivnn is then squarefree), but the IsSquarefree(n)=false branch (line 942) uses the unconditional sum '2*sum Hnn(...) + Hnn(-fourlnn)' which is only valid when n div nn is squarefree. Result: skp(2,m,n)(l) != skm(2,m,l,n) exactly when k=2, m/n is not a square and n is not squarefree. skm is the validated reference (newsz built on skm passes all LMFDB ALNewTrace/ALNewDims checks). Currently latent because the only caller chain (ALNewTraces -> newszp -> skp) is dead due to the newszp arity bug, but it must be fixed together with that bug or ALNewTraces will silently return wrong weight-2 traces for non-squarefree Q (e.g. Q=4,8,9).
findings.evidence: Sweep k in {2,4,6}, m in [1..36], n|m with GCD(n,m/n)=1, primes l coprime to m: 17 mismatches, ALL with profile [k=2, IsSquare(m/n)=false, IsSquarefree(n)=false]; e.g. skp(2,20,4)(7) = -1 vs skm(2,20,7,4) = -2; skp(2,24,8)(5) = 4 vs skm(2,24,5,8) = 2; skp(2,28,4)(3) = -1 vs skm = -2. After swapping the two A-expressions: 0 mismatches over the same sweep (and newszp built on it matches newsz everywhere).
findings.proposed_fix:
In lines 935-944 exchange the two A := ... expressions, i.e. make the IsSquarefree(n) branch use
A := &+[2*&+[ZZ|Hnn(s^2*nn2-fourlnn):s in [1..sb]] + Hnn(-fourlnn) where sb := ... : nn in dn]
and the else branch use
A := ZZ!&+[IsSquarefree(ndivnn) select ZZ!2*&+[ZZ|Hnn(s^2*nn2-fourlnn):s in [1..sb]] + Hnn(-fourlnn) else 2*&+[ZZ|Hnn(s^2*nn2-fourlnn):s in [1..sb]|IsSquarefree(GCD(s^2,ndivnn))] where sb := ... : nn in dn]

findings.description: The PrimesOnly:=false branch of ALNewTraces still iterates over PrimesInInterval(1,nmax), so it returns exactly the same set of n as PrimesOnly:=true, contradicting the docstring 'Trace of T(n)*W(Q) on S_k^new(N) for n <= nmax coprime to N ... Restricts to n prime by default.' With PrimesOnly:=false the caller should get traces for ALL n <= nmax coprime to N (including n=1 and composites). newsz is valid for composite coprime n (validated against LMFDB via ALNewTrace for n=1..12 including 4,6,8,9,10,12).
findings.evidence:
> ALNewTraces(11,2,10,11:PrimesOnly:=false);
[ 2, 1, -1, 2 ]  // 4 entries = primes 2,3,5,7 only; per the docstring it should be 10 entries for n=1..10 (all coprime to 11), e.g. n=1 entry -1 (=trace of W_11), n=4 entry -2, matching ALNewTrace(11,2,n,11) which is validated against LMFDB.

findings.description: Docstring says 'The Q-dimension of the new subspace of cuspdial forms of weight k for Gamma0(N)' but the intrinsic returns tomo1(k,N) = dim S_k(Gamma0(N)), the FULL cusp space (verified against Magma's Dimension(CuspForms(N,k)) for N<=60, k in {2,4,6,8,12} with 0 mismatches). The 'new subspace' phrase is a copy-paste from QDimensionNewCuspForms (line 1211). Both docstrings also misspell 'cuspidal' as 'cuspdial'.

Docstring says 'List of the first n coefficients of the trace form for the space of modular forms of weight k for Gamma0(N)', but the implementation shells out to pari's mftraceform([N,k]) whose default space is the NEW CUSPIDAL subspace S_k^new(N) (pari space=0 default; space=1 would be the full cuspidal space). So TraceForm returns the trace form of S_k^new(N), not of M_k(Gamma0(N)) nor even S_k(Gamma0(N)).

QDimensionCuspForms and QDimensionNewCuspForms (lines 1205-1213) have no require guards, unlike every neighboring intrinsic, and the underlying formulas tomo1/newtomo1 are only valid for even weight k >= 2. For odd or small k they silently return garbage instead of raising an error (dim S_k(Gamma0(N)) with trivial character is 0 for odd k; a dimension can never be negative).

Line 789 reads `elif v eq 4 then mm := s eq 0 select m(1-m) else -(m-s)*m*s;` — `m(1-m)` applies the integer m as a function, which raises a runtime error whenever the branch is reached (v = Valuation(N,m) = 4 and s = KroneckerSymbol(d,m) = 0). Clearly intended is `m*(1-m)`. Currently unreachable from any intrinsic: nutl is only called by newersz1p (line 1037), which is unused and explicitly marked '// TODO: currently broken' (line 1025), so severity is low, but the typo will bite whenever newersz1p is finished.
findings.evidence:
With the file's local functions loaded (stripped of intrinsics) after AttachSpec:
> nutl(2,5,16);  // t=2, l=5: D=-16, d=-4, m=2, s=KroneckerSymbol(-4,2)=0, v=Valuation(16,2)=4
Runtime error: Bad argument types
Argument types given: RngIntElt, RngIntElt

findings.description: In popa1p's k ne 2 branch, the summand multiplies by SNbase(N,t,p) twice: once via the prefix `s*` (with `where s:=SNbase(N,t,p)`) and again via the explicit `*SNbase(N,t,p)` factor, so terms with SNbase >= 2 are counted with SNbase^2. The k=2 branch (line 694) correctly has a single factor. popa1p(k,N,p) is the n=p specialization of popa1 (Popa Thm 4, l=1, l'=N) and must agree with popa1(k,N,p), which is validated (CuspTrace vs modular symbols, 0 mismatches). Sweep k in {2,4,6}, N<=30, p in {2,3,5,7}: 122 mismatches, all at k>2. Currently dead: popa1p is only called by newpopa1p (line 873), which no intrinsic uses.
findings.evidence: With local functions loaded: popa1p(4,5,2) = -6 but popa1(4,5,2) = -4 = Tr T_2 on S_4(5) (LMFDB 5.4.a.a has a_2=-4; CuspTrace(5,4,2) validated vs Trace(HeckeOperator(CuspidalSubspace(ModularSymbols(5,4,1)),2)) = -4). Also popa1p(4,3,2)=2 vs popa1=0, popa1p(4,8,7)=108 vs popa1=24; 122 mismatches in sweep, all with k>2 (k=2 branch agrees everywhere).

findings.description: childmin (lines 1089-1101) is unused work-in-progress code with three defects worth flagging before anyone wires it up: (1) a leftover debug statement `print C2,C3,C4;` at line 1099 that would pollute output; (2) line 1092 passes raw t to Gpk as `Gpk(k,t,n)`, but Gpk's second argument is t^2 (see its definition at line 426, 'Given, k,t^2,n', and every other call site, e.g. popa1 line 663 uses Gpk(k,t^2,n)); (3) it returns wrong values for its documented purpose (Child arXiv:2101.05663 Thm 2.1, chi=1, n prime). No intrinsic calls it, so no user-visible impact; recommend fixing the Gpk argument and removing the print, or deleting the function.

With local functions loaded:

-40 0 0            // debug print of C2,C3,C4
40                 // returned value; the correct Tr T_5 on S_4^new(6) is 6 (LMFDB 6.4.a.a a_5=6; NewTrace(6,4,5)=6, validated)
findings.proposed_fix: Minimal cleanup: delete line 1099 (`print C2,C3,C4;`) and change `Gpk(k,t,n)` to `Gpk(k,t^2,n)` in line 1092; the function needs further debugging (still wrong after these changes would need checking against Child Thm 2.1) or should be removed since it is unused.
